title: Desktop API envelope + casing normalisation (one unwrap helper; visa/travellers, notifications, users, tasks, lead notes)
goal: Every desktop API client returns the contract shapes (PaginatedResponse<T> / ApiResponse<T>, camelCase items) regardless of backend envelope quirks, so pages stop re-implementing unwrapping.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Owner default: normalise on the DESKTOP side; do not change backend envelopes (packages/shared Flutter models depend on them). Runtime envelope probe: /visa -> {data:{data,pagination}} without success; /notifications -> {data:{items,total,page,limit,data,pagination}}; /users unpaginated; /travellers -> {data:{data:[...snake_case...]}}; /tasks snake_case (and ignores camelCase dueDate on create - backend accepts camelCase after B12, so also send snake keys meanwhile); GET /leads/:id/notes returns created_by_name/created_at while leads/[id]/page.tsx:338 reads note.createdBy/note.createdAt -> "Unknown - Invalid Date". Reports /reports/:id returns {success,data:{data:[],columns,meta}} (pages fixed in B24 using this helper). Contract types: PaginatedResponse<T> {data:T[], pagination:{page,limit,total,totalPages}} and ApiResponse<T> in src/lib/api/client.ts (do not redefine). Find the travellers client (grep "travellers" in src/lib/api).
steps: Create src/lib/api/envelope.ts: unwrapList<T>(res, {page?, limit?}) -> PaginatedResponse<T> handling: bare array; {data:T[]}; {data:T[], pagination}; {data:{data:T[], pagination}}; {data:{items:T[], total, page, limit}}; {success, data:{data:T[], columns, meta}} (expose columns/meta via a second helper unwrapReport); unwrapEntity<T>(res) for {data:T} / {data:{data:T}} / T; camelizeKeys<T>(value) deep snake->camel that keeps existing camel keys and leaves Date/ISO strings untouched. Full unit tests (envelope.test.ts) for every shape.

Normalise clients (and update their unit tests): visa.ts (+ travellers client, adding email/phone fields from B08 to the Traveller type), notifications.ts (map reference_type/reference_id -> referenceType/referenceId, is_read -> read), users.ts (wrap unpaginated arrays), tasks.ts (camelCase items; create/update send camelCase AND the snake keys the current backend reads, e.g. due_date), leads.ts notes (createdBy, createdByName, createdAt).

Update call sites of the functions whose return shape changed so nothing regresses (grep each exported function name in src/app and src/components): keep page edits minimal (only the read-sites), e.g. leads/[id]/page.tsx notes render `note.createdByName ?? 'Unknown'` and `formatDate(note.createdAt)`. Do not refactor pages beyond read-sites (W6 batches own them).
Switch top-navbar.tsx notification click (added in B07) to the normalised fields only if it simplifies; otherwise leave it.
Typecheck, unit tests, and run the listed specs.
filesAllowlist: desktop/src/app/(app)/** and desktop/src/components/** (read-sites of changed functions only)
acceptance: Lead detail notes show author name and a valid date (no "Invalid Date").
visa, travellers, notifications, users, tasks lists render and paginate (specs).
lint-gate --zero passes for the API files you touched.
notes: Runs alone in the desktop lane for W3 (its read-site edits can land in any page).
